layers: Generated raster base with fixed complete mast and collar
Window light pulse - native pixel corrections
Radar bowl - pose draft refined at the joint

method: Imported the selected building at uniform 1/4 nearest-neighbor scale and corrected alpha. The complete tapered mast and elliptical collar stay fixed; every bowl pose is finished with native socket contour and material retouch. The neutral pose preserves the alpha-cleaned input outside joint_review_region; the joint region is also corrected in that pose. No architectural redraw.

radar.pose_draft: nearest-neighbor bowl pose, followed by native joint contour and material retouch

palette_policy: No artistic color-count cap; GIF global palette is a format encoding constraint.
visual_review: Independent read-only review inspected all eight native joint crops at 12x, all eight actual GIF-decoded joint crops in temporal order, a decoded whole-frame extreme, and the frame 7-to-0 loop boundary. No remaining reported mast/collar fracture, flat gray notch, or unexplained support ledge was found within joint_review_region. The tapered mast and collar retain their contours while the bowl changes pitch around its socket. GIF timing is eight 250 ms frames, totaling two seconds. This is a focused joint appearance review; source fidelity and runtime integration remain separate evidence.
